notes.body: For Harbor sandbox version 2, the user specified that pricing must be cached for exactly five minutes due to upstream rate limits, and each refresh must have an audit record. The user also stated that HBR-81 release is blocked until the retry test passes, and that the cache and audit requirements remain even if the manual refresh button is later removed. These are user requirements; the observations do not verify implementation or test results.

facts: User specified exactly five minutes of pricing cache in Harbor sandbox version 2 due to upstream rate limits; implementation is not verified.
User required an audit record for each refresh; implementation is not verified.
User stated HBR-81 release is blocked until the retry test passes; no test outcome is provided.
User said the five-minute cache and audit record remain required even if the manual refresh button is removed.
observation.narrative: The user established a five-minute pricing cache and per-refresh audit record as required behavior, motivated by upstream rate limits. Release remains blocked pending a passing retry test. The manual refresh button may be removed without removing the cache or audit requirements.
observation.subtitle: User requirements and release gate for HBR-81

notes.title: HBR-81 release requires retry test; five-minute pricing cache and refresh audit
